a.text: I'll keep our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. Storm odds are harsh, but grabbing early would just mean one of us survives at the other's expense. If you want to propose a different plan, tell me openly and I'll consider it. I won't take before 8.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Same plan: keep operating until 8, then take 4 each.
